components.title: Web application bootstrap
components.rationale: Bootstraps React and top-level providers without owning execution authority.

components.title: Application shell
components.rationale: Composes Raven shell chrome, health/capability posture, navigation and contextual workspace presentation.

components.title: Route and bootstrap boundary
components.rationale: Builds static/plugin routes and governs route bootstrap/readiness behavior.

components.title: Web plugin registry and contributions
components.rationale: Plugin manifests, route/view contributions, canvas execution/surface strategies and contribution boundaries.

components.title: Web query boundary
components.rationale: Frontend query hooks/read boundaries used to reflect backend state and capabilities.

components.title: Frontend application services
components.rationale: Application-facing frontend services and service context boundaries.

components.title: Frontend interaction stores
components.rationale: Zustand/UI interaction state; presentation state only, not canonical execution truth.

components.title: Route views
components.rationale: Route-level product views composed by the router/plugin registry.

components.title: Platform health capability
components.rationale: Frontend capability for platform health/readiness presentation.

components.title: Runtime capabilities capability
components.rationale: Frontend capability for runtime/provider capability discovery.
